entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-29
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • run command does not forward -binaryLogger option #49989
  • TypeScript Compilation in Razor Class Library causes build to fail in referencing projects #49988
  • Ability to inject project/package reference from command line #49985
  • Support uninstalling individual project templates #49982
  • Allow post copy dotnet tool install #49977

Closed

  • runtime is missing in global location #26052
  • Net6.0-windows(Winform project) cannot be referenced by .NETCore-App,Version=6.0(Xunit project) #26043
  • Microsoft Security Advisory CVE 2022-30184 | .NET Information Disclosure Vulnerability #26010
  • No warnings are generated for Trimmed or SingleFile apps when SCD is not specified and rid is specified other than via commandline #25925
  • ContentFiles not included with multiple TargetFrameworks and --no-incremental after upgrading to 6.0.300 #25758
  • dotnet build performance - Windows Vs MacOS Vs Linux #48541
    Discussion
  • Tool install seems to fail when installing a multi-targeted tool for a specific framework when other frameworks in the package are missing #49827
    Discussion
  • `dotnet restore` failes when a no_proxy environment variable exists, that starts with * #49983
  • Cannot use NuGet MCP server when using private feed #49981
  • Update test templates to use 3.10.0 instead of 3.9.3 #49986
  • [NetTestingE2E][Regression] Error "The library hostfxr.dll was found..." will throw when executing "dotnet test --arch x86 --diag:log1.txt". #49436
  • add deploy as a first class command #10291
    Backlog
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression]Redundant messages are displayed in terminal output when running .NET 10.0 project. #49965
  • The .NET CLI Does Not Speak the Universal Language of LLMs #49960

PullRequests

Created

  • Update MSTest in test templates (template_feed directory) to 3.10.0 #49987
  • make dicts in NamedPipeBase strong typed #49984

Merged

  • Fix forwarding DOTNET_ROOT #49634

Updated

  • Update the minimum msbuild version for .NET 10 #49531
  • Prepare delta applier for code sharing #49974
    Area-AspNetCore
  • Send Ctrl+C to launched process before killing it on Windows #49847
    Area-AspNetCore
  • Implement support for changing project and package references #49611
    Area-AspNetCore
  • Remove unnecessary license and xml headers #49963
    Area-Infrastructure
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #49947
    Area-AspNetCore, Area-CodeFlow
  • NuGet's dotnet cli commands should use common interactive option #49944
    Area-CLI
  • [release/10.0.1xx-preview7] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #49954
    Area-AspNetCore
  • Add 'RunCsWinRTGenerator' task and target #49417
